en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al Halby, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws, said, ‘I asked himasws about hunting the fish, and if he does not Name (Bismillah) over it. So heasws said: ‘There is no problem with it’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabiy who has said the following: “I once asked abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam,
about catching fish without a mention of the name of Allah. He (the Imam) said, ‘It is not unlawful.’”
